messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: high-severity — dedicated pool 'novusprime-prod' GPU utilization 100%, queue depth rising. Trigger: pool_exhaustion_threshold. Root ts=2419998888
oncall-elaine: taking this. I'll gather initial impact and call the dedicated ops room. ETA 2m.
eng-sre-raj: oncall-elaine can you share the pool id and which jobs are lining up?
oncall-elaine: pool: dp-az3-novusprime-prod. showing 120 queued requests, avg latency 1.9s -> 6.2s, tails at 18s. No obvious hardware failures. Looks like sustained spike from tenant traffic.
infra-lead-matt: confirmed, all hosts reporting full GPU memory and long NVLink wait. No node-level OOMs, just saturation.
eng-runtime-sam: can we evict non-critical background jobs in that pool? any batch jobs?
eng-sre-raj: there are 6 background backfill jobs tagged non-critical. If we evict them we free ~2 GPUs worth of capacity.
acct-novusprime-jane: NovusPrime is running one-off heavy scoring for a campaign, they flagged it's high priority. They explicitly disallow routing to shared hosted endpoints for compliance.
customer-success-lina: FYI customer will not accept cross-tenant fallback. They are okay with reduced throughput or short-term degraded latency, but want transparency.
pm-oliver: quick ask: do we have emergency burst tokens for this tenant? Any reserved spare capacity in us-east3?
infra-lead-matt: we have 8 GPU burst budget in us-east3 reserved for emergencies, but using it will trigger billing alert and requires account approval.
eng-sre-raj: propose sequence: 1) Evict non-critical batch jobs now (2 GPUs) 2) Apply emergency burst + spin up 6 GPUs to reach steady state 3) Apply temporary autoscale_windows to avoid re-surge 4) Notify billing and customer. Thoughts?
oncall-elaine: +1 to sequence. Eviction now.
eng-runtime-sam: also can enable model quantization/serve smaller variant for scoring jobs to drop memory per replica — should be transparent and keep inference in the dedicated pool (no hosted fallback). That could reduce GPU footprint by ~30%. Need restart of worker set (rolling).
acct-novusprime-jane: quantization is acceptable but only if model outputs are bit-for-bit compatible within tolerance. NovusPrime legal flagged strict output parity for regulation; they'd rather accept slightly higher latency than any change that affects correctness.
eng-runtime-sam: understood. Then skip quantization. We'll do eviction + burst.
infra-lead-matt: initiating eviction of non-critical jobs: evict-job --pool dp-az3-novusprime-prod --tag non-critical --mode graceful
ops-bot: Eviction job accepted. evict-id=ev-2419998890. Freeing 2 GPUs. ETA 90s.
ops-bot: Eviction completed. freed_gpus=2.
eng-sre-raj: pool util now 96% but queue down to 78. Still not enough. Requesting emergency burst.
oncall-elaine: Paging capacity team and requesting burst. @accounts please ACK.
pm-oliver: contacting finance/billing for approval now. @acct-novusprime-jane please confirm you approve emergency overage for 2h so we can allocate burst.
acct-novusprime-jane: approved for up to 3 hours. Please proceed.
infra-lead-matt: executing burst allocate: rbctl reserve-burst --tenant novusprime --pool dp-az3-novusprime-prod --gpus 6 --duration 3h --reason "emergency capacity for campaign spike"
ops-bot: burst-request accepted. request-id=br-2419998920. provisioning new nodes.
ops-bot: nodes provisioned and attached. +6 GPUs active.
eng-sre-raj: confirm metrics: queue down to 9, avg latency back to 2.1s, 95p at 4.5s. Error rate for long streaming sessions still elevated (0.8% -> 1.8%).
oncall-elaine: note: long sessions (>30s) still see intermittent truncations. Eng-runtime please look at KV cache pressure.
eng-runtime-sam: looking. KV cache hitting evictions on ~60% of long sessions causing re-compute. I can increase KV cache soft limit on this pool to reduce thrashing — that'll add ~1 GPU effective capacity. Rolling that now.
eng-runtime-sam: applied kv cache soft limit bump. immediate improvement in long-session tail. truncations dropping.
eng-sre-raj: good. current state: burst active + eviction done + kv tweak. customer impact: degraded tail and occasional truncated responses for long sessions for ~22 minutes prior to mitigation. No data moved off dedicated pool.
acct-novusprime-jane: thanks. Please send a note to NovusPrime legal and ops summary. They want an email within 30 minutes.
oncall-elaine: will prepare customer-facing incident summary and send.
pm-oliver: decision log: emergency burst approved by customer, used 6 GPUs for 3 hours. Evicted non-critical jobs and increased KV cache. Postmortem scheduled tomorrow 14:00 UTC.
eng-sre-raj: handing off monitoring to infra-lead-matt for the night. I'll stay on standby for escalation. Next update in 15m.
infra-lead-matt: ack. Taking watch.
customer-success-lina: I'll draft the message to NovusPrime and coordinate expectations.
incident-bot: Incident status changed: mitigated -> partial_mitigation. responders=[oncall-elaine,eng-sre-raj,infra-lead-matt,eng-runtime-sam].
oncall-elaine: final note before handoff: collect logs for the 20m spike window, tag with incident id ip-2419998888, include KV cache evictions, host Gpu stats, and queued request traces.
eng-sre-raj: logs collected and uploaded to incident bucket: s3://incidents/2419998888/logs.tar.gz
infra-lead-matt: handing off to night shift. if we see sustained >85% pool utilization after burst drains, do not auto-scale further without account sign-off.
acct-novusprime-jane: understood. We'll expect a detailed bill estimate for the burst.
pm-oliver: thanks everyone. Close loop tomorrow with postmortem and cost/architecture action items. :thumbsup:
